description: Read a Bible passage in one or more editions side by side (Hebrew WLC, Greek Septuagint, SBL Greek NT, English WEB/King James/ASV/Douay-Rheims/Brenton, Russian Synodal, Luther 1912, Louis Segond), each verse with its permanent link and a ready citation. Editions can be ids, short names or plain words ("kjv", "WEB", "Hebrew", "Greek"). Reference numbering is WEB, or WEB Classic for additional books it holds, otherwise Brenton. source_numbering identifies native verses. Unestablished correspondences are flagged aligned:false with no counterpart text. An unknown edition, a book an edition does not hold, or a verse range past the chapter's end is served as far as it can be and named in warnings[]; a verse or chapter that does not exist is an error with a hint.

editions.description: Editions, e.g. ["hebrew","lxx","kjv"] (ids from list_editions; a comma list works too). Defaults to the reference edition: en, web-full or lxx-en for that book.

name: get_passage

cite.description: Ready citation naming Scriptura, ending with the link.

error.description: What went wrong, in plain words.

resource.description: The same passage as a scriptura:// resource, readable as Markdown with resources/read.

warnings.description: What was adjusted to serve the request: each entry has a code, the fields that code names (what was asked, what was served) and a message. Absent when nothing was adjusted.
